text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, try putting what I've told you<n>into practice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Remember, only accelerate at the last<n>second, once
you're coming out of<n>the turn.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll give it my best shot!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look at her go. It's as if she's a<n>whole new runner
now. And it's all<n>thanks to your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My guidance? Haha. Well, don't stop<n>there. Please
heap on all the praise<n>you can.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. To tell the truth, I was<n>merely
parroting the advice my trainer<n>gave to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought he would appreciate it if I<n>passed on your
praise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought she would appreciate it if I<n>passed on your
praise.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I have to say it's rather<n>gratifying to see
one's own trainer<n>praised.
